name: glassvein-codex
description: Codex bridge for GlassVein session capture and MCP tool context injection.

interface.shortDescription: Capture Codex session state and bind GV MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: GlassVein Codex records Codex prompt/stop lifecycle metadata, can publish session_update events to a local GlassVein router, and injects session ownership into GV MCP tool calls through Codex hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use GlassVein MCP tools with the current Codex session context.
